stale_head_race_note_2026_10_06.phenomenon: Schedule runs pin head_sha at creation but read LIVE main via the API at execution. If a merge lands in between, the run verifies (and may replicate) a NEWER snapshot than its head_sha, and its check-run files under the stale head. Attribute replication writes by ANNOTATION TREES, not by head_sha filing.
